_about: Who each speaker sounds like. make_voice_refs.py (MeloTTS, ~/melo) speaks ref_text with melo/speed, then pitch-shifts it by pitch semitones (rubberband; formant: true keeps the vowel colour, so the voice sounds lower without sounding bigger) into tools/vo_refs/<who>.wav. make_voices_chatter.py (Chatterbox, ~/chatter) clones that clip for every line with exaggeration and cfg (lower cfg = slower, more deliberate); tempo (optional) time-stretches every take with rubberband, same pitch (0.9 = 10% slower). Grade 7 audience: friendly but not babyish, so pitch shifts stay mild and exaggeration a little under the cartoon end.

agni.ref_text: Good evening, everyone. I'm glad you're here. We have a big plan to make tonight, and we can do it together. Take your time, and trust yourself.

maya.creature: witch: playful and a little mischievous, still kind
maya.ref_text: Ooh, this is interesting. Every good spell needs the right ingredients. A pinch of numbers, a dash of letters, and a little mischief. Shall we see what happens?

neel.creature: yeti: big, gentle and slow, goofy rather than scary
neel.ref_text: Hello there, friend. I'm big and furry, but I'm very gentle. I like quiet evenings and good company. Hmm, maybe a party is a good idea.

nar.ref_text: Night falls softly over the forest. The lanterns glow, and the stars come out. In a little house on the hill, three friends are planning a special party.
